name: @playform/plugin-dsh-workspace-reflect
description: The workspace-reflect service: a DeepSeek Harness plugin providing the LATER-STAGE code-block reflective API - the AST-aware rename/connect/replace bundled as ONE call each, over the managed representations (the family map's reflect role; the workspace regime's interactions over the representations, where the reply IS part of the type). Each operation takes the whole transformation in one call - rename an identifier across the affected block/file references, connect two blocks with a reference, replace a block's span with new text - reads the current representation through ctx.fs, applies the transformation to the exact span, and publishes it through the factory's guarded write (the replaceIfVersion fence: a file that moved under the operation yields a conflict, never a silent overwrite). The reply union is the situated interaction protocol's CommitReply: applied / conflict / denied / rejected / recovery-required / outcome-unknown. After an applied operation the optional workspaceGraph service is asked to re-index the file so the graph's representation stays current (the reflective carry, contained). The plugin ships DISABLED - the IDLE-forever posture. Plan: Documentation/Plans/Workspace-Family/REFLECT.md.
